summary: Shared physical-layer metadata model. Four frozen dataclasses — ColumnInfo, TableInfo, NamespaceInfo, CatalogInfo — returned by all backend inspect_* methods regardless of backend type.
lifecycle_notes: All dataclasses are frozen — instances are immutable once created.
TableInfo.qualified_name and column_names are computed properties.
documentation_hooks: TableInfo.qualified_name property deserves explicit documentation — it assembles catalog.namespace.table
ColumnInfo.metadata is open-ended — backends can store dialect-specific extras here

evidence.detail: All four classes exported from package root
